titulo: Quiz — Three answers at the desk
introPt: A traveller reaches passport control in Athens with three short answers and one repair phrase.
cenario: Passport control, Athens airport, twenty minutes after landing.

dialogo.pt: Good morning. What is the purpose of your travel?

dialogo.es: Γεια σας. Είμαι για διακοπές. Δέκα μέρες.
dialogo.pt: Hello. I'm here on holiday. Ten days.
dialogo.tts: Γεια σας. Είμαι για διακοπές. Δέκα μέρες.

dialogo.es: Πού θα μείνετε; Έχετε την κράτηση;
dialogo.pt: Where will you be staying? Do you have the booking?
dialogo.tts: Πού θα μείνετε; Έχετε την κράτηση;

dialogo.es: Στην Αθήνα, σε ξενοδοχείο. Ναι, ορίστε.
dialogo.pt: In Athens, in a hotel. Yes, here you are.
dialogo.tts: Στην Αθήνα, σε ξενοδοχείο. Ναι, ορίστε.

perguntas.pergunta: What are the three questions the desk is actually asking?
opcoes: Your job, your income and your return date
Why you came, how many days, where you sleep
Your address at home, your employer and your insurer
Your itinerary, your budget and your travel companions
perguntas.explica: Purpose, length, address. Three separate answers, each one waiting for its own question.

perguntas.pergunta: The question arrives bare, with no softening in front of it. What does that tell you?
opcoes: That the officer is annoyed with you
Nothing about you — the two languages put politeness in different places
That you should switch to English immediately
That your paperwork has a problem
perguntas.explica: Comparative research describes Greek as oriented to involvement and closeness, English to distance and non-imposition. The missing cushion carries no message.

perguntas.pergunta: «Ορίστε» — what is it doing when you hand over the booking?
opcoes: Apologising for the delay
Asking the officer to repeat
Here you are — it hands the thing over and ends the sentence
Confirming your name
perguntas.explica: Ορίστε has three jobs: here you are, go ahead, and sorry, what? At a desk it is the first, and it moves the exchange onto your evidence.

perguntas.pergunta: A woman saying she is travelling alone says:
opcoes: Ταξιδεύω μόνος μου
Ταξιδεύω μόνη μου
Ταξιδεύω μόνο
Ταξιδεύω μόνοι
perguntas.explica: Μόνος μου for a man, μόνη μου for a woman. One letter, and it is the only thing in the sentence that moves.

perguntas.pergunta: Can you count on the officer speaking English?
opcoes: Yes — everyone in Greek public service does
No — English is rare in Greece
Sometimes, and the three Greek answers work either way
Only in the summer season
perguntas.explica: Greece ranks high on commercial self-selected English indices, but those measure people who chose to sit an online test, not a population. Speaking is the weakest of the four skills. Have the three answers ready anyway.
